title: Guatemalan Illegal Arrested for Child Rape After 12-Year-Old Victim Gives Birth in Alabama
text:
An illegal alien from Guatemala has been arrested for horrific sex crimes against a preteen victim after she gave birth to his child in Alabama, according to reports.
On Tuesday, 26-year-old Manuel Andres Francisco Tomas was apprehended by the Marshall County Sheriff’s Office (MSCO) and charged with first-degree rape.
The Marshall County Criminal Investigations Division was alerted after a 12-year-old girl gave birth at a local hospital.
Investigators have already matched the newborn’s DNA to that of the suspect, 1819 News reports.
Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) has lodged a detainer for Francisco Tomas with the MCSO Detention Center.
